patterns.batch_dialog_pattern: Multi-step dialog with progress tracking, using BulkPRDialog as pattern. Steps: options -> creating -> results. Use ScrollArea for lists, Progress for tracking, Badge for status.
patterns.keyboard_shortcut_pattern: App.tsx has keyboard listener pattern (lines 375-411). Use useEffect with addEventListener 'keydown', check e.ctrlKey/e.metaKey + e.key, skip if in input fields.
patterns.dialog_system: Use shadcn/ui Dialog components (Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogFooter). All dialogs have onOpenChange callback for state management.
patterns.i18n_pattern: Use react-i18next with namespaces. Import useTranslation, const { t } = useTranslation(['namespace', 'common']). All user-facing text must use translation keys, not hardcoded strings.
patterns.store_pattern: Zustand stores follow pattern: create() with state interface + actions. Use slice pattern for updates to avoid re-renders. Stores persist to filesystem via settings-store.
patterns.ipc_pattern: IPC handlers in main/ipc-handlers/, preload API in preload/api/. Task operations: getTasks, startTask, updateTaskStatus, submitReview all follow same pattern.

existing_implementations.description: Found existing batch operations and keyboard shortcut patterns in codebase

keyboard_shortcuts.pattern: useEffect with keydown listener, Cmd/Ctrl+T for add project
keyboard_shortcuts.note: Checks if target is input field to avoid interfering with typing

ui_components.note: All components follow consistent API and styling patterns

component_conventions.structure: Co-locate components with hooks and stores
component_conventions.styling: Tailwind CSS with cn() utility for class merging
